title: Abortion Care in Missouri
overview:
**Project Overview**

            A journalism project examining abortion care in Missouri and the effects of changing legislation and access to reproductive healthcare.



            **Role / Responsibilities**

            Conducted research, gathered information from sources, developed the story, and produced the final journalistic project as part of my university studies.

title: Celebrate Pride among drag queens and fine art at the Future is Femme Ball
overview:
**Project Overview**

            The June 18 event at the 21c Museum Hotel will honor femme queens and trans folks with a party for a good cause. The feature highlights the intersection of drag, fine art, LGBTQ+ community, and fundraising.



            **Role / Responsibilities**

            Researched the event, gathered information about the performers and venue, developed the feature, and wrote the article for St. Louis Magazine.

title: Duane Reed Gallery’s ‘Small Works Invitational’ returns to highlight regional artists
overview:
**Project Overview**

            The exhibition returns to the Central West End gallery following a three-year hiatus, highlighting regional artists and their small-scale works.



            **Role / Responsibilities**

            Researched the exhibition and participating artists, developed the arts feature, gathered relevant information about the show's return, and wrote the article for St. Louis Magazine.

title: Embrace fantasy at Faeded, the costume party where communal resistance meets queer art
overview:
**Project Overview**

            First Friday: Faeded returns to the Contemporary Art Museum St. Louis and Pulitzer Arts Foundation with the premiere of *Faeded–The Opera*. The feature explores the event's combination of costume, queer art, performance, and community.



            **Role / Responsibilities**

            Researched the event and participating arts organisations, developed the culture feature, gathered information about the programme, and wrote the article for St. Louis Magazine.

title: Great Rivers Greenway will unveil plans for more than 60 artworks along the Brickline Greenway at CAM Art Party
overview:
**Project Overview**

            Enjoy local food, live music, and arts and craft activities on August 5 while hearing from renowned artists and community leaders. The feature explores Great Rivers Greenway's plans for more than 60 artworks along the Brickline Greenway.



            **Role / Responsibilities**

            Researched the Brickline Greenway and its public art programme, gathered information from artists and community leaders, developed the story, and wrote the article for St. Louis Magazine.

title: How a St. Louis rapper set the tone for the U.S. Men’s World Cup run
overview:
**Project Overview**

            This feature explores how St. Louis rapper and artist educator Mvstermind created original music for the World Cup documentary *U.S. Against the World*. The story examines his connection to St. Louis, his creative process, and how his music became part of the U.S. Men’s National Team's World Cup story.



            **Role / Responsibilities**

            Researched and reported the feature, conducted interviews, developed the story angle, and wrote the article for St. Louis Magazine.

title: Inside the Rave Collective MATERIA
overview:
**Project Overview**

            This feature explores MATERIA and the Rave Collective, looking at the people, creativity, and community behind the project and its place within St. Louis' queer arts and nightlife scene.



            **Role / Responsibilities**

            Researched the collective, developed the story, gathered information, and wrote the feature for OUT IN STL.

title: Massive summer carnival brings rides, circus shows, and family fun to Metro East
overview:
**Project Overview**

            With more than 100 rides and attractions, free circus performances, character meet-and-greets, and discount days, the Super Fair promises eight days of family fun just across the river.



            **Role / Responsibilities**

            Researched the event, gathered information about attractions and activities, developed the feature, and wrote the article for St. Louis Magazine.

title: Meet the Concrete Cowboys and the creation of The New School’s newest subculture
overview:
**Project Overview**

            This feature explores the Concrete Cowboys and the development of a new subculture at The New School, examining the people, identity, and community surrounding the group.



            **Role / Responsibilities**

            Researched the community, developed the story, conducted interviews, and wrote the feature for The New School Free Press.

title: No Kings March
overview:
**Project Overview**

            A photojournalism and reporting project documenting the No Kings March and examining the event, participants, and surrounding political context.



            **Role / Responsibilities**

            Attended and documented the event, conducted research, gathered material, and developed the project as part of my university journalism studies.

title: Principia students design 3D-printed devices to help people with disabilities
overview:
**Project Overview**

            Two teams from the St. Louis school became finalists in the international Make:able Challenge after designing assistive devices for members of the local community.



            **Role / Responsibilities**

            Researched the students' projects, reported on their designs and community partnerships, developed the story, and wrote the article for St. Louis Magazine.

title: Samhain: How witches of New York City celebrate October 31st
overview:
**Project Overview**

            A feature exploring how witches in New York City celebrate Samhain and the cultural and spiritual traditions surrounding October 31st.



            **Role / Responsibilities**

            Researched Samhain traditions, explored contemporary practices, developed the story, and produced the project as part of my university journalism studies.

title: September gardening tips for St. Louisans
overview:
**Project Overview**

            From cleaning your beds to planting a tree, September offers plenty of work for home gardeners to do. This feature provides seasonal gardening advice for St. Louisans.



            **Role / Responsibilities**

            Researched the seasonal gardening topic, interviewed Ian Graves of Quiet Village Landscaping, developed the story, and wrote the article for St. Louis Magazine.

title: St. Louis County Greek Fest returns this Memorial Day Weekend
overview:
**Project Overview**

            The free festival immerses guests in Greek culture with authentic dishes, folk dancing, and live music.



            **Role / Responsibilities**

            Researched the festival, gathered information about the programme and traditions, developed the story, and wrote the article for St. Louis Magazine.

title: Stanley Browne launches Cellar & Table, a new wine and hospitality venture in St. Louis
overview:
**Project Overview**

            The longtime St. Louis hospitality veteran's new venture will offer consulting, wine education and global food-and-wine trips. The feature explores Browne's career and his plans for Cellar & Table.



            **Role / Responsibilities**

            Researched the new business and Browne's hospitality background, developed the feature, reported on the venture's services, and wrote the article for St. Louis Magazine.

title: Tamm Story Slamm encourages community connection through storytelling
overview:
**Project Overview**

            How a monthly backyard story slam became a beloved St. Louis event. Tamm Story Slamm creates a community-driven space where people can share personal stories and connect with one another.



            **Role / Responsibilities**

            Researched the event, interviewed organisers and participants, developed the story, and wrote the feature for St. Louis Magazine.

title: The Opera Bell Band’s new album, A Salute to Corn, does just that
overview:
**Project Overview**

            The band's release party includes corn dishes, corny games, and scientifically accurate lyrics about the essential American crop. The feature explores The Opera Bell Band's new album, *A Salute to Corn*.



            **Role / Responsibilities**

            Researched the band and album, developed the story angle, gathered information about the release party, and wrote the article for St. Louis Magazine.

title: WerQfest will return bigger and bolder than ever this July
overview:
**Project Overview**

            The annual festival celebrating the Black, queer, and trans communities returns to Atomic by Jamo July 11.



            **Role / Responsibilities**

            Researched the festival, gathered event information, developed the story, and wrote the article for St. Louis Magazine.
